Before you enquire

Useful answers.

Which booking length should I choose?+

A single set suits a focused feature or cocktail hour. Two sets serve shorter venue and private bookings. Three sets provide the full upbeat arc. Four sets suit extended events and can include the dedicated jazz and swing set.

Can the music stay quieter early in the event?+

Yes. Acoustic songs and full-production arrangements are interspersed throughout the show, and the balance can be shaped around the room.

What does the venue need to provide?+

Allow approximately 2 × 2 metres, access to standard power and a safe performance area. Outdoor bookings need adequate cover from sun, rain and weather.

Can Robert travel beyond Sydney and the Hunter Valley?+

Yes. Bookings are available across NSW, with travel included in the tailored quote.
